limits: The explicitly labeled alternative XY cases are explicitly labeled mathematical feasibility diagnostics, not reviewed candidate evidence or per-view sprite corrections. Any chosen new worldpath must be common to all facings, native and actual unchanged sprite presentation.
Positive finite area alone is not automatic usability approval. Inspect visible stability/overhang and recheck body/post/cap clearance under the actual chosen root law.
This analysis does not make the supplied original traversal pass; new source-independent context/physical evidence must be supplied and reviewed.
